whatIs.title: What Is Impacted Tooth Removal?
whatIs.description: Impacted tooth removal is a dental surgical procedure performed when a tooth fails to erupt properly due to lack of space or incorrect positioning. This commonly affects wisdom teeth but can also occur with other teeth. Removing an impacted tooth helps:

goals.title: Reduce the risk of cyst formation
Prevent crowding and damage to adjacent teeth

whatIs.consultationText: If you're experiencing pain or swelling around the back of your mouth, searching for impacted tooth removal near me is the first step toward relief with Prudentia Micro Dental Care.

whyEssential.title: Signs You May Need Impacted Tooth Removal
whyEssential.highlight: You may require impacted tooth removal if you experience:
whyEssential.description: Pain at the back of the mouth, swollen or tender gums, jaw pain or stiffness, difficulty opening your mouth, food getting trapped around partially erupted teeth, recurrent gum infections, bad breath caused by infection, or damage to neighboring teeth. Early treatment can prevent more serious dental complications.

treatments.title: Types of Impacted Tooth Removal Available Near You
items: Wisdom Tooth Removal – removal of impacted or partially erupted wisdom teeth causing pain, infection, or crowding
Surgical Tooth Extraction – recommended for teeth that are trapped beneath the gums or bone and cannot be removed through a simple extraction
Partial Bony Impaction Removal – performed when part of the tooth is covered by bone and requires minor surgical access
Complete Bony Impaction Removal – for teeth completely enclosed within the jawbone requiring advanced surgical extraction

items.question: How long does impacted tooth removal take?
items.answer: Most impacted tooth removal procedures are completed within 30 to 60 minutes, depending on the complexity of the tooth.

items.question: Is impacted tooth removal painful?
items.answer: No. The procedure is performed under local anesthesia, making it comfortable. Mild soreness after the procedure is normal and can usually be managed with prescribed medications.

items.question: How long does recovery take?
items.answer: Most patients recover within 3 to 7 days, although complete healing of the surgical area may take a few weeks.

items.question: Who is a suitable candidate for impacted tooth removal?
items.answer: Anyone with an impacted, partially erupted, infected, or problematic tooth may be a suitable candidate after a thorough dental examination.

items.question: What is the cost of impacted tooth removal in Pune?

items.question: Why should I remove an impacted tooth instead of leaving it untreated?
items.answer: Removing an impacted tooth helps prevent pain, infection, damage to neighboring teeth, cyst formation, gum disease, and other oral health complications.
